items.period: Bronze-script style; the file description does not identify a specific inscription date or period
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 卓 in bronze-script style. It illustrates an early form tradition for the phonetic element discussed in 桌, but does not show an attested early 桌 or prove how 桌 was formed.
items.alt: Black bronze-script-style graph 卓 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Shows a source-described ancient script form of 卓, the independently analyzed sound component; Commons identifies the Hanziyuan source image and declares this SVG representation public domain.
items.rights: Commons declares the vector representation public domain; the description credits the Hanziyuan source image B12552 and cites permission from Richard Sears.

items.period: Seal-script style; no specific artifact date is supplied
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 卓 in a seal-script style associated with Shuowen. It is a later script-style reference, not a photograph of an excavated object or evidence for the date of 桌.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style graph 卓 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: Offers a clearly labeled later graphic reference to compare with the bronze-style rendering; source page identifies the character and public-domain status of the vector.
items.rights: Commons declares the vector representation public domain; the description credits the Hanziyuan source image S05940 and cites permission from Richard Sears.

limitations.text: Commons description pages identify these as modern vector redrawings based on Hanziyuan image records. The proposed image candidates are not photographs of inscribed artifacts, and no image pixels were visually inspected in this research stage.
The source image pages concern 卓, not 桌. They can illustrate the proposed phonetic component’s script history but cannot demonstrate an early 桌 graph or confirm a merge of 卓’s 十 with 木.
